metadata.title: Support program enrollment requirements
metadata.source: Fictional support program enrollment policy, version 1, requirements and established interpretations. https://example.org/program/policies/enrollment/1

criteria.statement: The provider's enrollment file contains a signed participation form for the selected program, patient, and enrollment episode, dated on or before the review date. A complete search of that file with no qualifying form establishes that this documentation requirement is not satisfied.

The patient completed live orientation for the selected program and this enrollment episode on or before the review date. Absence of a record does not establish that orientation did not occur; the finding remains unresolved when the available evidence cannot establish completion.

The selected program accepted the patient's prior orientation with that program for this enrollment episode on or before the review date. Absence of a record does not establish that acceptance did not occur; the finding remains unresolved when the available evidence cannot establish acceptance.

activities.outcome: HTTP 200, clarified. Supplied the established interpretation of live orientation from policy version 1.

body.question: Does live orientation include a real-time video session with a program instructor?

body.explanation: Live orientation includes a real-time session with a program instructor, either in person or by video. A prerecorded session alone does not qualify.
